assumptions: API version 2026-07 is assumed because the status filter and user_config field used for full coverage are only available in 2026-07 and later; earlier versions default to ACTIVE and PENDING only.
Personal API token is sent in the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix as shown in the cURL example, so empty prefix is used.
OAuth app authentication is mentioned but no token URL is documented, so only API token auth is included.
Users query uses status [ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PENDING] to include deactivated users; omitted status would default to ACTIVE and PENDING only.
Pagination uses page starting at 1 and limit with maximum 1000; total pages and has-more indicators are not documented so null is used and fetching stops on empty/short page.
Role and user type are derived from user_config.kind (admin, member, guest, view_only); view_only is treated as member type and full mapping for API/service account kinds could not be confirmed.
last_activity and created_at are date strings, so no numeric format is needed.
Rate limit of 5000 requests per minute is documented but exact remaining and reset header names are not stated, so those fields are null.
Errors are returned with HTTP 200 and an errors array, but there is no ok-style success flag documented, so no errorEnvelope is set.
Single global endpoint https://api.monday.com/v2 is used; no tenant-specific subdomain is needed.
